dedupe_keys.name: managing the uncertainty of the u value measurement using an auxiliary set along with a thermal camera

description: Georgios Papadakos and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The completed study develops an auxiliary in-situ measurement setup used with a thermal camera and compares its response against simultaneous thermocouple measurements. It analyses uncertainty in the resulting thermal-transmittance estimate, a parameter used in building heat-loss calculations and renovation decisions. The source establishes a physical measurement and verification application, without claiming a complete building-energy simulator or unrestricted release of experimental readings. No numeric uncertainty budget is provided in the abstract. The case helps users assess the evidential limits of envelope parameters supplied to thermal models under the documented measurement method. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label other-closed. These terms describe the deposit; a paper licence does not establish a software licence. Coverage is limited to the stated sites, model settings and application examples. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected. Linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
